verses.text_uthmani: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: Alif, Lām, Rā.<sup foot_note=196583>1</sup> These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
trs.85: Alif Lam Ra These are the verses of the Scripture, a Quran that makes things clear.
trs.22: A. L. R. These are the Ayats of Revelation,- of a Qur'an that makes things clear.
trs.203: Alif-Lâm-Râ. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings].These are Verses of the Book and a plain Qur’ân.

verses.text_uthmani: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

trs.20: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish<sup foot_note=196584>1</sup> that they had been Muslims.
trs.85: The disbelievers may well come to wish they had submitted to God,
trs.22: Again and again will those who disbelieve, wish that they had bowed (to Allah's will) in Islam.
trs.203: How much would those who disbelieved wish that they had been Muslims [those who have submitted themselves to Allâh’s Will in Islâm i.e. Islâmic Monotheism - this will be on the Day of Resurrection when they will see the disbelievers going to Hell and the Muslims going to Paradise].<sup foot_note=154644>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
trs.85: so [Prophet] leave them to eat and enjoy themselves. Let [false] hopes distract them: they will come to know.
trs.22: Leave them alone, to enjoy (the good things of this life) and to please themselves: let (false) hope amuse them: soon will knowledge (undeceive them).
trs.203: Leave them to eat and enjoy, and let them be preoccupied with (false) hope. They will come to know!

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

trs.20: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
trs.85: Never have We destroyed a community that did not have a set time;
trs.22: Never did We destroy a population that had not a term decreed and assigned beforehand.
trs.203: And never did We destroy a township but there was a known decree for it.

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

trs.20: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
trs.85: no community can bring its time forward, nor delay it.
trs.22: Neither can a people anticipate its term, nor delay it.
trs.203: No nation can advance its term, nor delay it.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ

trs.20: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.<sup foot_note=196585>1</sup>
trs.85: They say, ‘Receiver of this Quran! You are definitely mad.
trs.22: They say: "O thou to whom the Message is being revealed! truly thou art mad (or possessed)!
trs.203: And they say: "O you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) to whom the Dhikr (the Qur’ân) has been sent down! Verily, you are a mad man!

verses.text_uthmani: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

trs.20: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
trs.85: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are telling the truth?’
trs.22: "Why bringest thou not angels to us if it be that thou hast the Truth?"
trs.203: "Why do you not bring angels to us if you are of the truthful?"

verses.text_uthmani: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ

trs.20: We do not send down the angels except with truth;<sup foot_note=196586>1</sup> and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.
trs.85: But We send down the angels only to bring justice and then these people will not be reprieved.
trs.22: We send not the angels down except for just cause: if they came (to the ungodly), behold! no respite would they have!
trs.203: We send not the angels down except with the truth (i.e. for torment), and in that case, they (the disbelievers) would have no respite!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
trs.85: We have sent down the Quran Ourself, and We Ourself will guard it. Even before you [Prophet],
trs.22: We have, without doubt, sent down the Message; and We will assuredly guard it (from corruption).
trs.203: Verily, We, it is We Who have sent down the Dhikr (i.e. the Qur’ân) and surely, We will guard it (from corruption)<sup foot_note=154645>1</sup>.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muḥammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
trs.85: We sent messengers among the various communities of old,
trs.22: We did send messengers before thee amongst the religious sects of old:
trs.203: Indeed, We sent (Messengers) before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) amongst the sects (communities) of old.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

trs.20: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
trs.85: but they mocked every single messenger that came to them:
trs.22: But never came a messenger to them but they mocked him.
trs.203: And never came a Messenger to them but they did mock at him.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

trs.20: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.
trs.85: in this way We make the message slip through the hearts of evildoers.
trs.22: Even so do we let it creep into the hearts of the sinners -
trs.203: Thus do We let it (polytheism and disbelief) enter the hearts of the Mujrimûn [criminals, polytheists and pagans (because of their mocking at the Messengers)].

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
trs.85: They will not believe in it. That was what happened with the peoples of long ago,
trs.22: That they should not believe in the (Message); but the ways of the ancients have passed away.
trs.203: They would not believe in it (the Qur’ân); and already the example of (Allâh’s punishment of) the ancients (who disbelieved) has gone forth.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ

trs.20: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
trs.85: and even if We opened a gateway into Heaven for them and they rose through it, higher and higher,
trs.22: Even if We opened out to them a gate from heaven, and they were to continue (all day) ascending therein,
trs.203: And even if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they were to keep on ascending thereto (all the day long)

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ

trs.20: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
trs.85: they would still say, ‘Our eyes are hallucinating. We are bewitched.’
trs.22: They would only say: "Our eyes have been intoxicated: Nay, we have been bewitched by sorcery."
trs.203: They would surely say (in the evening): "Our eyes have been (as if) dazzled (we have not seen any angel or heaven). Nay, we are a people bewitched."

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ

trs.20: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
trs.85: We have set constellations up in the sky and made it beautiful for all to see,
trs.22: It is We Who have set out the zodiacal signs in the heavens, and made them fair-seeming to (all) beholders;
trs.203: And indeed, We have put the big stars in the heaven and We beautified it for the beholders.<sup foot_note=154646>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ

trs.20: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]
trs.85: and guarded it from every stoned satan:
trs.22: And (moreover) We have guarded them from every cursed devil:
trs.203: And We have guarded it (near heaven) from every outcast Shaitân (devil).

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
trs.85: any eavesdropper will be pursued by a clearly visible flame.
trs.22: But any that gains a hearing by stealth, is pursued by a flaming fire, bright (to see).
trs.203: Except him (devil) who steals the hearing then he is pursued by a clear flaming fire.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ

trs.20: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
trs.85: As for the earth, We have spread it out, set firm mountains on it, and made everything grow there in due balance.
trs.22: And the earth We have spread out (like a carpet); set thereon mountains firm and immovable; and produced therein all kinds of things in due balance.
trs.203: And the earth We have spread out, and have placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein all kinds of things in due proportion.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

trs.20: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.<sup foot_note=196587>1</sup>
trs.85: We have provided sustenance in it for you and for all those creatures for whom you do not provide.
trs.22: And We have provided therein means of subsistence,- for you and for those for whose sustenance ye are not responsible.
trs.203: And We have provided therein means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not [moving (living) creatures, cattle, beasts, and other animals].

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

trs.20: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.
trs.85: There is not a thing whose storehouses are not with Us. We send it down only according to a well-defined measure:
trs.22: And there is not a thing but its (sources and) treasures (inexhaustible) are with Us; but We only send down thereof in due and ascertainable measures.
trs.203: And there is not a thing, but with Us are the stores thereof. And We send it not down except in a known measure.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ

trs.20: And We have sent the fertilizing winds<sup foot_note=196588>1</sup> and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
trs.85: We send the winds to fertilize, and We bring down water from the sky for you to drink- you do not control its sources.
trs.22: And We send the fecundating winds, then cause the rain to descend from the sky, therewith providing you with water (in abundance), though ye are not the guardians of its stores.
trs.203: And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then cause the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We give it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like].

translation.text: and We gave it to you to drink

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

trs.20: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.<sup foot_note=196589>1</sup>
trs.85: It is We who give life and death; it is We who inherit [everything].
trs.22: And verily, it is We Who give life, and Who give death: it is We Who remain inheritors (after all else passes away).
trs.203: And certainly We! We it is Who give life, and cause death,<sup foot_note=154647>1</sup> and We are the Inheritors.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ

trs.20: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
trs.85: We know exactly those of you who come first and those who come later.
trs.22: To Us are known those of you who hasten forward, and those who lag behind.
trs.203: And indeed, We know the first generations of you who had passed away, and indeed, We know the present generations of you (mankind), and also those who will come afterwards.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ

trs.20: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
trs.85: [Prophet], it is your Lord who will gather them all together: He is all wise, all knowing.
trs.22: Assuredly it is thy Lord Who will gather them together: for He is perfect in Wisdom and Knowledge.
trs.203: And verily, your Lord will gather them together. Truly, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

trs.20: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
trs.85: We created man out of dried clay formed from dark mud-
trs.22: We created man from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape;
trs.203: And indeed, We created man from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ

trs.20: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
trs.85: the jinn We created before, from the fire of scorching wind.
trs.22: And the Jinn race, We had created before, from the fire of a scorching wind.
trs.203: And the jinn, We created aforetime from the smokeless flame of fire.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

trs.20: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
trs.85: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a mortal out of dried clay, formed from dark mud.
trs.22: Behold! thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man, from sounding clay from mud moulded into shape;
trs.203: And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "I am going to create a man (Adam) from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ

trs.20: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,<sup foot_note=196590>1</sup> then fall down to him in prostration."
trs.85: When I have fashioned him and breathed My spirit into him, bow down before him,’
trs.22: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
trs.203: "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves unto him."

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

trs.20: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
trs.85: and the angels all did so.
trs.22: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
trs.203: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

trs.20: Except Iblees;<sup foot_note=196591>1</sup> he refused to be with those who prostrated.
trs.85: But not Iblis: he refused to bow down like the others.
trs.22: Not so Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
trs.203: Except Iblîs (Satan) - he refused to be among the prostrators.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
trs.85: God said, ‘Iblis, why did you not bow down like the others?’
trs.22: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! what is your reason for not being among those who prostrated themselves?"
trs.203: (Allâh) said: "O Iblîs (Satan)! What is your reason for not being among the prostrators?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

trs.20: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
trs.85: and he answered, ‘I will not bow to a mortal You created from dried clay, formed from dark mud.’
trs.22: (Iblis) said: "I am not one to prostrate myself to man, whom Thou didst create from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape."
trs.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "I am not the one to prostrate myself to a human being, whom You created from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it,<sup foot_note=196592>1</sup> for indeed, you are expelled.
trs.85: ‘Get out of here!’ said God. ‘You are an outcast,
trs.22: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here; for thou art rejected, accursed.
trs.203: (Allâh) said: "Then, get out from here, for verily, you are Rajîm (an outcast or a cursed one)." [Tafsîr At-Tabarî]

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

trs.20: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
trs.85: rejected until the Day of Judgement.’
trs.22: "And the curse shall be on thee till the day of Judgment."
trs.203: "And verily, the curse shall be upon you till the Day of Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

trs.20: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
trs.85: Iblis said, ‘My Lord, give me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead.’
trs.22: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
trs.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
trs.85: ‘You have respite,’ said God,
trs.22: (Allah) said: "Respite is granted thee
trs.203: Allâh said: "Then, verily, you are of those reprieved,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

trs.20: Until the Day of the time well-known."
trs.85: ‘until the Day of the Appointed Time.’
trs.22: "Till the Day of the Time appointed."
trs.203: "Till the Day of the time appointed."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
trs.85: Iblis then said to God, ‘Because You have put me in the wrong, I will lure mankind on earth and put them in the wrong,
trs.22: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! because Thou hast put me in the wrong, I will make (wrong) fair-seeming to them on the earth, and I will put them all in the wrong,-
trs.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Because you misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

trs.20: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
trs.85: all except Your devoted servants.’
trs.22: "Except Thy servants among them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
trs.203: "Except Your chosen, (guided) slaves among them."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
trs.85: God said, ‘[Devotion] is a straight path to Me:
trs.22: (Allah) said: "This (way of My sincere servants) is indeed a way that leads straight to Me.
trs.203: (Allâh) said: "This is the Way which will lead straight to Me."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ

trs.20: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
trs.85: you will have no power over My servants, only over the ones who go astray and follow you.
trs.22: "For over My servants no authority shalt thou have, except such as put themselves in the wrong and follow thee."
trs.203: "Certainly, you shall have no authority over My slaves, except those who follow you of the Ghâwûn (Mushrikûn and those who go astray, criminals, polytheists, and evil-doers).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
trs.85: Hell is the promised place for all these,
trs.22: And verily, Hell is the promised abode for them all!
trs.203: "And surely, Hell is the promised place for them all.

translation.text: (is) surely the promised place for them

verses.text_uthmani: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ

trs.20: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."
trs.85: with seven gates, each gate having its allotted share of them.
trs.22: To it are seven gates: for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned.
trs.203: "It (Hell) has seven gates, for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

trs.20: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,
trs.85: But the righteous will be in Gardens with springs-
trs.22: The righteous (will be) amid gardens and fountains (of clear-flowing water).
trs.203: "Truly! The Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) will be amidst Gardens and water-springs (Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

trs.20: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
trs.85: “Enter them in peace and safety!”––
trs.22: (Their greeting will be): "Enter ye here in peace and security."
trs.203: "(It will be said to them): ‘Enter therein (Paradise), in peace and security.’

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

trs.20: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment,<sup foot_note=196593>1</sup> [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
trs.85: and We shall remove any bitterness from their hearts: [they will be like] brothers, sitting on couches, face to face.
trs.22: And We shall remove from their hearts any lurking sense of injury: (they will be) brothers (joyfully) facing each other on thrones (of dignity).
trs.203: "And We shall remove from their breasts any deep feeling of bitterness (that they may have). (So they will be like) brothers facing each other on thrones.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ

trs.20: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
trs.85: No weariness will ever touch them there, nor will they ever be expelled.’
trs.22: There no sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave.
trs.203: "No sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave it."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

trs.20: [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
trs.85: [Prophet], tell My servants that I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
trs.22: Tell My servants that I am indeed the Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful;
trs.203: Declare (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) unto My slaves, that truly, I am the Oft-Forgiving, the Most-Merciful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ

trs.20: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
trs.85: but My torment is the truly painful one.
trs.22: And that My Penalty will be indeed the most grievous Penalty.
trs.203: And that My Torment is indeed the most painful torment.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

trs.20: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
trs.85: Tell them too about Abraham’s guests:
trs.22: Tell them about the guests of Abraham.
trs.203: And tell them about the guests (the angels) of Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ

trs.20: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."
trs.85: when they came to him and said, ‘Peace,’ he said, ‘We are afraid of you.’
trs.22: When they entered his presence and said, "Peace!" He said, "We feel afraid of you!"
trs.203: When they entered unto him, and said: Salâm (peace)! [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Indeed! We are afraid of you."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

trs.20: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
trs.85: ‘Do not be afraid,’ they said, ‘We bring you good news of a son who will have great knowledge.’
trs.22: They said: "Fear not! We give thee glad tidings of a son endowed with wisdom."
trs.203: They (the angels) said: "Do not be afraid! We give you glad tidings of a boy (son) possessing much knowledge and wisdom."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

trs.20: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
trs.85: He said, ‘How can you give me such news when old age has come to me? What sort of news is this?’
trs.22: He said: "Do ye give me glad tidings that old age has seized me? Of what, then, is your good news?"
trs.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Do you give me glad tidings (of a son) when old age has overtaken me? Of what then is your news?"

translation.text: Do you give me glad tidings
Do you give me glad tidings

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ

trs.20: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
trs.85: They said, ‘We have told you the truth, so do not despair.’
trs.22: They said: "We give thee glad tidings in truth: be not then in despair!"
trs.203: They (the angels) said: "We give you glad tidings in truth. So be not of the despairing."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

trs.20: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
trs.85: He said, ‘Who but the misguided despair of the mercy of their Lord?’
trs.22: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, but such as go astray?"
trs.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "And who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except those who are astray?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

trs.20: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
trs.85: and then asked, ‘Messengers, what is your errand?’
trs.22: Abraham said: "What then is the business on which ye (have come), O ye messengers (of Allah)?"
trs.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham) again] said: "What then is the business on which you have come, O Messengers?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

trs.20: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
trs.85: They replied, ‘We have been sent to a people who are guilty.’
trs.22: They said: "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin,
trs.203: They (the angels) said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners).

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
trs.85: But We shall save the household of Lot,
trs.22: "Excepting the adherents of Lut: them we are certainly (charged) to save (from harm),- All -
trs.203: "(All) except the family of Lût (Lot). Them all we are surely going to save (from destruction).

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ

trs.20: Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.<sup foot_note=196594>1</sup>
trs.85: all except his wife: We have decreed that she will be one of those who stay behind.
trs.22: "Except his wife, who, We have ascertained, will be among those who will lag behind."
trs.203: "Except his wife, of whom We have decreed that she shall be of those who remain behind (i.e. she will be destroyed)."

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

trs.20: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
trs.85: When the messengers came to the household of Lot,
trs.22: At length when the messengers arrived among the adherents of Lut,
trs.203: Then, when the Messengers (the angels) came unto the family of Lût (Lot).

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

trs.20: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
trs.85: he said, ‘You are strangers.’
trs.22: He said: "Ye appear to be uncommon folk."
trs.203: He said: "Verily! You are people unknown to me."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

trs.20: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
trs.85: They said, ‘We have brought you what they said would never happen:
trs.22: They said: "Yea, we have come to thee to accomplish that of which they doubt.
trs.203: They said: "Nay, we have come to you with that (torment) which they have been doubting.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ

trs.20: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
trs.85: we have brought you the Truth. We speak truly,
trs.22: "We have brought to thee that which is inevitably due, and assuredly we tell the truth.
trs.203: "And we have brought you the truth (the news of the destruction of your nation) and certainly, we tell the truth.

translation.text: And we have come to you

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ

trs.20: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
trs.85: so leave in the dead of the night with your household, and walk behind them. Let none of you look back. Go where you are commanded.’
trs.22: "Then travel by night with thy household, when a portion of the night (yet remains), and do thou bring up the rear: let no one amongst you look back, but pass on whither ye are ordered."
trs.203: "Then travel in a part of the night with your family, and you go behind them in the rear, and let no one amongst you look back, but go on to where you are ordered."

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ

trs.20: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
trs.85: We made this decree known to him: the last remnants of those people would be wiped out in the morning.
trs.22: And We made known this decree to him, that the last remnants of those (sinners) should be cut off by the morning.
trs.203: And We made known this decree to him, that the root of those (sinners) was to be cut off in the early morning.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

trs.20: And the people of the city came rejoicing.<sup foot_note=196595>1</sup>
trs.85: The people of the town came along, revelling,
trs.22: The inhabitants of the city came in (mad) joy (at news of the young men).
trs.203: And the inhabitants of the city came rejoicing (at the news of the young men’s arrival).

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

trs.20: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
trs.85: and he told them, ‘These are my guests, do not disgrace me.
trs.22: Lut said: "These are my guests: disgrace me not:
trs.203: [Lût (Lot)] said: "Verily! these are my guests, so shame me not.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ

trs.20: And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."
trs.85: Fear God, and do not shame me.’
trs.22: "But fear Allah, and shame me not."
trs.203: "And fear Allâh and disgrace me not."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
trs.85: They answered, ‘Have we not told you not to interfere [between us and] anyone else?’
trs.22: They said: "Did we not forbid thee (to speak) for all and sundry?"
trs.203: They (people of the city) said: "Did we not forbid you from entertaining (or protecting) any of the ‘Âlamîn (people, foreigners and strangers from us)?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ

trs.20: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters<sup foot_note=196596>1</sup> - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
trs.85: He said, ‘My daughters are here, if you must.’
trs.22: He said: "There are my daughters (to marry), if ye must act (so)."
trs.203: [Lût (Lot)] said: "These (the girls of the nation) are my daughters (to marry lawfully), if you must act (so)."

verses.text_uthmani: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

trs.20: By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
trs.85: By your life [Prophet], they wandered on in their wild intoxication
trs.22: Verily, by thy life (O Prophet), in their wild intoxication, they wander in distraction, to and fro.
trs.203: Verily, by your life (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم), in their wild intoxication, they were wandering blindly.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ

trs.20: So the shriek<sup foot_note=196597>1</sup> seized them at sunrise.
trs.85: and the blast overtook them at sunrise:
trs.22: But the (mighty) Blast overtook them before morning,
trs.203: So As-Saihah (torment - awful cry) overtook them at the time of sunrise.

verses.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

trs.20: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
trs.85: We turned their city upside down and rained on them a shower of clay stones.
trs.22: And We turned (the cities) upside down, and rained down on them brimstones hard as baked clay.
trs.203: And We turned (the towns of Sodom in Palestine) upside down and rained down on them stones of baked clay.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

trs.20: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
trs.85: There truly is a sign in this for those who can learn-
trs.22: Behold! in this are Signs for those who by tokens do understand.
trs.203: Surely! In this are signs for those who see (or understand or learn the lessons from the Signs of Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ

trs.20: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
trs.85: it is still there on the highway-
trs.22: And the (cities were) right on the high-road.
trs.203: And verily! They (the cities) were right on the highroad (from Makkah to Syria i.e. the place where the Dead Sea is now)<sup foot_note=154648>1</sup>.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
trs.85: there truly is a sign in this for those who believe.
trs.22: Behold! in this is a sign for those who believed.
trs.203: Surely! Therein is indeed a sign for the believers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
trs.85: The forest-dwellers, too, were wrongdoers
trs.22: And the Companions of the Wood were also wrong-doers;
trs.203: And the Dwellers in the Wood [i.e. the people of Madyan (Midian) to whom Prophet Shu‘aib (عليه السلام) was sent by Allâh), were also Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers).

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
trs.85: and We took retribution on them; both are still there on the highway, plain for all to see.
trs.22: So We exacted retribution from them. They were both on an open highway, plain to see.
trs.203: So, We took vengeance on them. They are both on an open highway, plain to see.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

trs.20: And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr<sup foot_note=196598>1</sup> [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
trs.85: The people of al-Hijr also rejected Our messengers:
trs.22: The Companions of the Rocky Tract also rejected the messengers:
trs.203: And verily, the dwellers of Al-Hijr (the rocky tract) denied the Messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

trs.20: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
trs.85: We gave them Our signs, but they turned their backs.
trs.22: We sent them Our Signs, but they persisted in turning away from them.
trs.203: And We gave them Our Signs, but they were averse to them.

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

trs.20: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
trs.85: They carved out dwellings in the mountains, and lived in security-
trs.22: Out of the mountains did they hew (their) edifices, (feeling themselves) secure.
trs.203: And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains (feeling themselves) secure.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ

trs.20: But the shriek seized them at early morning,
trs.85: the blast overwhelmed them early in the morning.
trs.22: But the (mighty) Blast seized them of a morning,
trs.203: But As-Saihah (torment - awful cry) overtook them in the early morning (of the fourth day of their promised punishment days).

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

trs.20: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
trs.85: What they had gained was of no use to them.
trs.22: And of no avail to them was all that they did (with such art and care)!
trs.203: And all that they used to earn availed them not.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ

trs.20: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
trs.85: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them without a true purpose: the Hour will certainly come, so [Prophet] bear with them graciously.
trs.22: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, but for just ends. And the Hour is surely coming (when this will be manifest). So overlook (any human faults) with gracious forgiveness.
trs.203: And We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with truth, and the Hour is surely coming, so overlook (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) their faults with gracious forgiveness. [This was before the ordainment of Jihâd - holy fighting in Allâh’s cause].

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

trs.20: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
trs.85: Your Lord is the All Knowing Creator.
trs.22: For verily it is thy Lord who is the Master-Creator, knowing all things.
trs.203: Verily, your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ

trs.20: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses]<sup foot_note=196599>1</sup> and the great Qur’ān.
trs.85: We have given you the seven oft-recited versesand the whole glorious Quran.
trs.22: And We have bestowed upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Grand Qur'an.
trs.203: And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of Al-Mathâni (seven repeatedly recited Verses), (i.e. Sûrat Al-Fâtihah) and the Grand Qur’ân.<sup foot_note=154649>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
trs.85: Do not look longingly at the good things We have given some to enjoy. Do not grieve over the [disbelievers], but lower your wings over the believers
trs.22: Strain not thine eyes. (Wistfully) at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them, nor grieve over them: but lower thy wing (in gentleness) to the believers.
trs.203: Look not with your eyes ambitiously at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them (the disbelievers), nor grieve over them. And lower your wings for the believers (be courteous to the fellow-believers).

verses.text_uthmani: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

trs.20: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
trs.85: and say, ‘I am here to give plain warning,’
trs.22: And say: "I am indeed he that warneth openly and without ambiguity,"-
trs.203: And say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم): "I am indeed a plain warner."

verses.text_uthmani: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ

trs.20: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators<sup foot_note=196600>1</sup>
trs.85: like the [warning] We have sent down for those who divide themselves into bands
trs.22: (Of just such wrath) as We sent down on those who divided (Scripture into arbitrary parts),-
trs.203: As We have sent down on the dividers, (Quraish pagans or Jews and Christians).

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ

trs.20: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.<sup foot_note=196601>1</sup>
trs.85: and abuse the Quran––
trs.22: (So also on such) as have made Qur'an into shreds (as they please).
trs.203: Who have made the Qur’ân into parts. (i.e. believed in one part and disbelieved in the other). [Tafsir At-Tabari]

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
trs.85: by your Lord, We will question them all
trs.22: Therefore, by the Lord, We will, of a surety, call them to account,
trs.203: So, by your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم), We shall certainly call all of them to account.

verses.text_uthmani: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: About what they used to do.
trs.85: about their deeds.
trs.22: For all their deeds.
trs.203: For all that they used to do.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

trs.20: Then declare what you are commanded<sup foot_note=196603>1</sup> and turn away from the polytheists.<sup foot_note=196602>2</sup>
trs.85: So proclaim openly what you have been commanded [to say], and ignore the idolaters.
trs.22: Therefore expound openly what thou art commanded, and turn away from those who join false gods with Allah.
trs.203: Therefore proclaim openly (Allâh’s Message - Islâmic Monotheism) that which you are commanded, and turn away from Al-Mushrikûn (polytheists, idolaters, and disbelievers - See V.2:105).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ

trs.20: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
trs.85: We are enough for you against all those who ridicule your message,
trs.22: For sufficient are We unto thee against those who scoff,-
trs.203: Truly! We will suffice you against the scoffers,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.
trs.85: who set up another god beside God- they will come to know.
trs.22: Those who adopt, with Allah, another god: but soon will they come to know.
trs.203: Who set up along with Allâh another ilâh (god); but they will come to know.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

trs.20: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
trs.85: We are well aware that your heart is weighed down by what they say.
trs.22: We do indeed know how thy heart is distressed at what they say.
trs.203: Indeed, We know that your breast is straitened at what they say.

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ

trs.20: So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
trs.85: Celebrate the glory of your Lord and be among those who bow down to Him:
trs.22: But celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves in adoration.
trs.203: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be of those who prostrate themselves (to Him).<sup foot_note=154650>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ

trs.20: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
trs.85: worship your Lord until what is certain comes to you.
trs.22: And serve thy Lord until there come unto thee the Hour that is Certain.
trs.203: And worship your Lord until there comes unto you the certainty (i.e. death).<sup foot_note=154651>1</sup>
